blocks.content: Take a second and let that sink in. You just finished the Learn C++ Basics course.
You started with cout << "Hello, World!;, and now you know how to:

items: Make decisions with if and else

blocks.content: That's not just learning the basics. That's learning how to think in code.
You've gone from beginner to someone who can write real C++. Most people don't get this far. You did. That matters.
